title: Mathematical Sampling Engine Bundle
description: Create mathematical/sampling: a full-blown, feature-rich, production-grade, model-agnostic LLM token-sampling engine in pure Rust as a single flattened crate mathematical_sampling (mathematical/sampling/rs/lib.rs), following the mathematical/random precedent (one lib.rs, #region markers, zero external deps besides path dep on mathematical_random). Scope: full processor pipeline (warpers: temperature/dynamic-temperature/top-k/top-p/min-p/typical/locally-typical/tail-free/epsilon/eta/top-a/rank-truncation/adaptive-truncation), penalties (repetition/presence/frequency/decaying/token-class/no-repeat-ngram/phrase), biases/masks (sparse/dense bias, allow/forbid, special-token suppression, position rules, bad-words, encouragement), length/forced-token controls, selection algorithms (greedy/multinomial/gumbel-max/gumbel-top-k), adaptive samplers (Mirostat v1/v2, entropy PID, repetition/confidence controllers), hand-rolled constraint engine (regex NFA/DFA, EBNF/Earley grammar, JSON mode, JSON-Schema subset, trie, must-include), stop-condition system with Aho-Corasick and streaming hold-back, splittable counter-based RNG with per-request/sequence/beam/candidate streams, per-sequence mutable state with fork/rollback/checkpoint/serialization, batch + continuous-batching support, search-based decoding (beam/diverse-beam/stochastic-beam/constrained-beam/best-of-n/contrastive/rejection sampling), exact speculative decoding preserving target distribution, logprobs/diagnostics, observability hooks, security/DoS limits, sharded-vocabulary sampling via a Collective trait with in-process reference impl, and an optional diffusion/continuous-noise module (noise schedules, Euler/Heun/LMS/DDIM/PLMS/DPM/DPM++/UniPC solvers, CFG guidance, img2img/inpaint). Zero external dependencies, hand-rolled JSON/regex/serialization, matching the mathematical/* purity precedent. Wire up project.json/package.json/script.ts, register in root Cargo.toml workspace members and .vscode/launch.json, and add minimal additive Rng::state/from_state accessors to mathematical/random/rs/lib.rs.
summary:
Implemented `mathematical_sampling` — a single flattened crate (`mathematical/sampling/rs/lib.rs`, ~9,650 lines) following the `mathematical/random` precedent: one `lib.rs` organized in `#region`-marked sections, zero external dependencies beyond a path dep on `mathematical_random`, hand-rolled JSON/regex/EBNF/serialization throughout.

Delivered (all real, compiling, tested — 179 tests, 0 failures, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean):
- Core types: TokenId/SequenceId/StepIndex, SamplingError, FinishReason, fallback ladder, SamplingLimits.
- Hand-rolled JSON parser/writer, UTF-8 incremental validator.
- Numerics: stable softmax/log-softmax (f32/f64 accum), Kahan summation, entropy, quickselect top-k, CDF binary search.
- Dense TokenBitset (the shared hard-mask representation).
- Splittable counter-based RNG (`CounterRng`) keyed by `StreamKey{request,sequence,beam,candidate,purpose}` plus a `mathematical_random::Rng` adapter; added minimal `Rng::state`/`Rng::from_state` accessors to `mathematical_random` for this.
- Vocabulary metadata, TokenTextAdapter trait, Schedule enum (constant/linear/exponential/cosine/piecewise/by-position/entropy-scaled/callback) with JSON round-trip.
- SamplingConfig with builder, full validation, presets (precise/balanced/creative/deterministic_test), versioned JSON serde, fingerprinting.
- LogitsWorkspace (grow-only, steady-state-allocation-free prob-sort machinery) and the full processor pipeline: all warpers (temperature, dynamic-temperature, top-k/p, min-p, typical, locally-typical, tail-free, epsilon, eta, top-a, rank-truncation, adaptive-truncation), penalties (repetition/presence/frequency/decaying/token-class/no-repeat-ngram/phrase), biases/masks (logit bias sparse+dense, allow/forbid, suppress-special, bad-words, sequence-encouragement), length/forced-token controls, selection algorithms (greedy, multinomial ×3 strategies, Gumbel-max, Gumbel-top-k), adaptive samplers (Mirostat v1/v2, entropy PID, repetition/confidence controllers).
- Stop-condition system: hand-rolled Aho-Corasick with streaming hold-back, token- and text-sequence stops.
- Constraint engine: hand-rolled regex NFA→DFA (byte-level, no backtracking, budget-checked) with a lazy per-state token-feasibility cache, trie/must-include/JSON-mode/EBNF (grammar-to-regex inlining, bounded recursion)/JSON-Schema-subset constraints.
- SequenceState with fork/rollback/checkpoint/restore and versioned fingerprinted text serialization; a full transactional stateful engine (`sample_step`) plus a stateless one-shot path (`sample_step_stateless`); Observability (Null/CollectingObserver).
- Batch: ContinuousBatcher (id-keyed, reorder-invariant, workspace-pool-reusing).
- Search: beam search (GNMT length penalty, per-beam independent forked state), best-of-n, rejection sampling.
- Speculative decoding: exact accept/residual-resample/bonus-token algorithm, statistically verified against direct target sampling.
- Sharded-vocabulary sampling: `Collective` trait + in-process `LocalCollective` reference impl, sharded softmax/top-k/sample verified bit-close to unsharded.
- Diffusion module: noise schedules (linear/scaled-linear/cosine/Karras/exponential/polynomial/custom), Denoiser trait, Euler/Euler-ancestral/Heun/DDIM solvers, classifier-free guidance with rescale, img2img start-index, inpaint mask blending, cancellable step callback.

Two real bugs were found and fixed via the property/statistical test suite itself: (1) a per-step RNG re-derivation bug in the stateful engine that made every step draw the same value (now uses the sequence's persistent stream directly); (2) the Walker's-alias-method construction had an eager-double-`.pop()` bug that silently zeroed one bucket's probability — fixed in this crate's local copy; the identical bug exists in `mathematical_random::AliasTable` and was filed as a separate task (not fixed here, out of this ticket's scope) rather than fixed silently.

Scope cuts (documented in code comments, not silently dropped): diverse-beam/stochastic-beam/contrastive-search beam variants, PLMS/DPM/DPM++/UniPC multistep diffusion solvers, proactive (vs. reactive) JSON-mode/JSON-Schema token masking, full Earley/GLR grammar support (EBNF compiles via bounded rule-inlining into the regex DFA instead — non-recursive/boundedly-recursive grammars only), GPU backends, C/Python/WASM FFI, external tensor-framework adapters.

Verification: `cargo build/test/clippy -p mathematical_sampling` clean (isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` used to sidestep ~100+ concurrent-session lock contention on the shared target dir); `cargo test -p mathematical_random` still 30/30 green after the additive `Rng::state`/`from_state` change; `bun ./script.ts lint` in `mathematical/sampling` verified end-to-end through the real nx/bun wiring path (completed clean, though slow — ~155min — due to the same shared-lock contention).
